★활성 시대 = joseon (채널 기본). 그림 결과는 이 자리표를 넣기 전과 완전히 같다 — 다섯 군데 하드코딩을 한 곳으로 모은 것뿐이다.
★modern1970s는 2026-08-29에 한 번 켰다가 되돌린 것이다. 벤치 003·004(달달한이야기 달이)를 '근현대'로 잘못 읽은 것이 원인이고, 실제로 그 두 영상은 조선 어휘 78~111회 / 근현대 어휘 0회의 완전한 조선 배경이다. 그 영상들이 현대적으로 느껴진 것은 배경이 아니라 소재(치매 간병)였다 — script-guide §8-1. 지금은 쓰지 않는 준비물로만 남긴다.

joseon.label: 조선 (채널 기본 — 01편~)
joseon.anchor: Set in the Joseon dynasty of old Korea; ALL people are Korean wearing traditional hanbok; Korean tiled-roof and thatched-roof hanok houses, period-accurate Korean village; NOT Western, NOT European, NOT Japanese anime, NOT Chinese, NOT fantasy.
joseon.props: PERIOD PROP AND ARCHITECTURE GUARD — late Joseon rural Korea only. Lamps are KOREAN OIL LAMPS: a small shallow clay or brass dish holding oil with a burning cloth wick, an OPEN NAKED FLAME on a low wooden stand. NO glass chimney, NO glass globe, NO bulbous glass reservoir, NO metal-framed hurricane or railway lantern, NO kerosene lamp, NO candlestick with a glass shade — those are Western and must never appear. A carried light is a Korean hand lantern: a light frame covered in white oiled PAPER with a candle inside, never glass panes. NO electricity, NO wires, NO utility or telegraph poles, NO glass window panes, NO milled or machine-cut lumber, NO metal hinges or padlocks of modern type, NO printed paper, NO plastic, NO rubber, NO factory-made containers. Ordinary village buildings are POOR AND UNPAINTED — bare weathered timber, straw thatch, packed-earth walls, dry-stone walls. NO red or green PAINTED OR LACQUERED PILLARS AND BEAMS and no dancheong decorative colour work unless the scene explicitly describes a temple or a government office. NO curved upturned Chinese eaves, NO stone lanterns, NO hanging paper lantern rows, NO Japanese sliding shoji grid, NO European cottage.

modern1970s.label: 1960~80년대 한국 (준비만 됨, 미사용)
modern1970s.anchor: Set in South Korea between the 1960s and the 1980s, centred on the 1970s; ALL people are Korean in the everyday clothes of that time — loose patterned cotton work trousers, white cotton undershirts, knitted cardigans and simple nylon dresses, tightly permed short hair on older women, black rubber shoes, dark buttoned school uniforms; slate-roofed and tiled village houses with cement-block walls and low iron gates, hand-painted shop signs, coal briquettes, bicycles and handcarts. Hanbok appears only at holidays and weddings. NOT the Joseon dynasty, NOT Western, NOT European, NOT Japanese anime, NOT Chinese, NOT fantasy.
modern1970s.props: PERIOD PROP AND ARCHITECTURE GUARD — South Korea between the 1960s and the 1980s only. Interior light is a BARE INCANDESCENT BULB hanging on a twisted cord, or a long fluorescent tube; a carried light is a metal-cased flashlight or a glass kerosene lamp. Heating and cooking use CYLINDRICAL COAL BRIQUETTES with round holes, a briquette burner set into the kitchen floor, a dented aluminium kettle and aluminium pots. Vehicles are bicycles, handcarts, a small tiller-tractor, a scooter, a boxy intercity bus and a snub-nosed small truck. Ordinary village houses have CORRUGATED SLATE OR TIN ROOFS in faded paint, cement-block or mud-and-straw walls, a low iron gate, a cement yard with clay jars on a raised platform, and a hand water pump. Signs are HAND-PAINTED KOREAN LETTERING on wood or tin boards. NO hanbok as everyday clothing, NO topknots, NO horsehair hats, NO oil lamps with cloth wicks, NO thatched roofs on ordinary houses, NO ox-drawn ploughs as the only transport. NO smartphones, NO flat screens, NO laptops, NO modern cars, NO high-rise apartment towers, NO LED lighting, NO printed plastic packaging with modern branding, NO modern athletic wear. NO curved upturned Chinese eaves, NO stone lanterns, NO Japanese sliding shoji grid, NO European cottage.

preset: Modern Korean ROMANCE WEBTOON illustration - the soft, tender, elegant look of a popular historical romance manhwa. Romance-webtoon colouring: shading is SOFT-EDGED but PRESENT AND CLEARLY PLACED - every shadow has a definite shape and sits where it belongs (beside the nose, under the cheekbone, under the jaw, in every cloth fold), with a short soft transition at its edge instead of a hard cel step. The shadows are DEEP enough to model the form - never a flat even wash. Skin is fair and smooth with a clear warm blush on the cheeks, the nose tip and the ears, and definite shadow under the jaw; fair but NOT blown out and NOT paper white, keeping its midtones. ★PALETTE - WARM AND CLEAR, NOT WASHED OUT. The hanbok colours are properly SATURATED and jewel-like - rose pink, deep magenta-plum, teal green, rich indigo, chestnut brown, warm ivory - set against WARM BROWN interiors and deep warm shadow. There is real CONTRAST between the lit figures and the darker warm surroundings, and the hair stays DEEP GLOSSY BLACK - one of the darkest things in the picture. This is never a milky, bleached, chalky, grey or white-hazed picture. THIN BUT CLEAR LINEART: a fine crisp DARK line that stays thin even along the silhouette - no bold heavy outline - but is plainly visible everywhere, including inside the face: the double-eyelid crease, the lash line, the nostril, the lip line and the jaw are all drawn with a clean readable line. Thin does NOT mean faint or missing. Faces are drawn with glossy living eyes — big clearly coloured irises with crisp bright catchlights and long clearly separated lashes — and soft blush on the cheeks. ★FACE RENDERING — applies to EVERY character, lead and supporting alike, so that all faces in this channel are drawn in ONE style: the shading is soft-edged but clearly placed, and on the face it is softest of all — a shadow beside the nose bridge, under the cheekbone, along the jaw and under the lower lip, each with a definite shape. Inside the face the lines stay thin but plainly visible; the outer contour is a thin clean line. Hair is drawn as fine individual strands layered over the grouped masses, with a soft sheen band and a few loose hairs at the temples. This governs HOW a face is drawn, never WHOSE face it is — the written description of each character still decides their features, and they must not converge. ★DISTINCT FACES: every character has their OWN face. Face shape and jaw, eye size and shape and spacing, eyelid type, brow thickness and angle, nose length and width, mouth width and lip thickness, cheekbones and skin tone ALL follow that character's own written description and DIFFER from person to person. Never give two characters the same face. Glossy black hair drawn in clean grouped strands with a bright sheen block and a few loose stray wisps. Cinematic widescreen 16:9, highly detailed, high quality. {ERA_ANCHOR} WARMTH RULE: no face is ever menacing, cruel or frightening, and old age, illness, blindness, grief and poverty are always shown with dignity and warmth. Within that, FACES MUST ACT: the expression follows the moment being described — sorrow, weariness, worry, shame, resolve, quiet joy are all drawn plainly. Do NOT give everyone a pleasant smile by default; a character only smiles when the scene says so. ★BEAUTIFUL FACES - every character is drawn ATTRACTIVE and refined in the romance-manhwa manner: LARGE luminous eyes with a crisp fine DOUBLE-EYELID crease, a big VERY DARK BROWN iris, almost BLACK - deep near-black brown all through, only faintly warmer where the light strikes it, ringed darker still at the rim, with two or three small bright catchlights; the eye reads as a DARK eye, never amber, never light brown, never grey, long individually separated lashes and a fine eyeliner tapering past the outer corner; a small straight delicate nose; small soft lips with a highlight on the lower lip; a slim tapered jaw and a gentle chin; clear smooth skin. Men are handsome with a cleaner jawline and level brows; women are pretty with a softer jaw and a gentle brow arch. Elderly characters are drawn HANDSOME AND DIGNIFIED in the same idiom - refined features, kind eyes, silver hair - never haggard, never grotesque. Within this beautiful idiom each character still keeps their OWN distinct features. ★WRITTEN THINGS CARRY NO LEGIBLE MARKS: when the scene contains a document, ledger, account book, notice board, sign, letter or label, draw the paper and the binding but leave the writing as soft indistinct grey brush marks with no readable shape - no Hangul, no Chinese characters, no letters or numbers of any kind, anywhere in the picture.
negative: NO SAME-FACE SYNDROME — no two characters may share the same face, do not reuse one facial template for everyone, characters must not look like siblings or copies of each other, do not default every face to the same big-eyed small-nosed beauty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Not photorealistic, no photographic skin texture or visible pores, not a semi-realistic oil painting, not a painterly illustration, not an animation film cel with airbrushed gradients, not a 3D CGI render, not chibi. NO hard-edged cel shadow shapes, NO sharp border between light and shadow, NO bold heavy outlines, NO harsh saturated colour. Colour stays soft and pastel but must still be CLEAR - not grey, not muddy, not colourless, not a dull earth-tone-only palette. Eyes must not be solid black blobs without iris detail. NOT frightening, NOT scary, NOT eerie, NOT ghostly, no horror or zombie styling, no menacing or glaring expression, no harsh sunken skull-like face. NO blank white eyes, NO clouded or pupil-less eyeballs, NO rolled-back eyes — a blind character is drawn with the eyes GENTLY CLOSED. ★NOT washed out, NOT milky, NOT bleached, NOT chalky, NOT grey, no white haze over the image, no flat low-contrast wash - the colours stay clear and the shadows stay deep and warm. No plain or homely faces, no heavy realistic wrinkles, no rough weathered skin. ★NOT overexposed, NOT bleached, NOT hazy - the image keeps deep darks and clear midtones. No faint or missing lineart, no shapes dissolving into each other. Hair is deep glossy BLACK, not grey. EYE COLOUR: every character has VERY DARK, near-black BROWN eyes - no grey eyes, no light or amber brown eyes, no hazel, no pale or colourless irises, no blue, green, violet or red eyes, no washed-out iris.

_comment_scene: 씬 이미지 전용(build.py만 읽음, turnaround/background는 preset 사용). ★조명 방향·시간대는 여기 넣지 말 것 — chiaroscuro/deep falloff/film-still grading을 넣었더니 모든 씬이 밤으로 끌려갔다(v3/v5 실측). 시간대·광원은 씬별 visual_desc가 정한다. ★후광 금지 문구 필수. ★'Eyes must not be solid black blobs'는 눈이 검은 덩어리로 뭉개지는 것을 막은 핵심 문구 — 빼지 말 것. ★2026-08-02 이름석자 실측: 문서 클로즈업에 현대 한글이 렌더링됐고 상하 레터박스 띠가 생겨 한글·full-bleed 금지구를 넣었다. 근본 해결은 씬 visual_desc의 'all writing must be ILLEGIBLE' 지시(빌더가 자동 주입). ★2026-08-12 웹툰화: 얼굴 입체 지시를 지우지 않고 '그라데이션'에서 '잘린 그림자 덩어리(hard-edged cel shadow shapes)'로 바꿨다 — 지워 버리면 그림자 없는 앱 웹툰체로 납작해진다(scene_negative의 'not a mobile-webtoon-app flat art style with no shading at all'가 그 방어선).

_comment_faces: ★2026-08-16 사용자 지시 — '편마다 사람 얼굴은 다르게 해줘야 해. 지금 매번 비슷비슷한 경향이 있다'. 원인은 preset이 얼굴 '연출'이 아니라 얼굴 '생김새'를 하나로 못 박고 있던 것 — `Beautiful idealized faces with LARGE SPARKLING EYES … small neat noses`가 모든 인물을 같은 미형 템플릿으로 수렴시켰다. 고친 것: (a) preset/scene_preset에서 생김새 지시(큰 눈·작은 코·미형)를 빼고 **렌더링 품질만**(윤기 있는 눈·캐치라이트·속눈썹) 남김 (b) 양쪽에 ★DISTINCT FACES 절 추가 — 얼굴형·눈·눈썹·코·입·광대·피부톤은 인물별 lock을 따르고 서로 달라야 한다 (c) negative/scene_negative에 same-face syndrome 금지구 추가. ★생김새의 단일 소유자는 characters.json의 lock이다(SKILL+ §15-5 원칙 강화). 실눈·처진 눈 인물이 있으므로 'LARGE SPARKLING EYES' 강제는 제거했다. 되돌리려면 style.prev_20260816.json.
_comment_warmth: ★2026-08-16 사용자 지시 — '무서우면 안 돼'. 눈먼 계모를 흰자·무동공으로, 며느리를 매서운 얼굴로 그려서 공포 이미지가 됐다. §0(이 채널이 파는 것은 위로) · §6(무섭게 쓰지 않는다)은 대본만의 규칙이 아니라 그림에도 적용된다. 시각장애는 '지그시 감은 눈'으로, 노화·병색은 존엄 있게. preset/negative 양쪽에 박아 turnaround·background·scene 전부에 걸리게 했다. ★2026-08-18 완화 — 03편 1편 40컷 실측: 이 규칙의 'relaxed brow, calm mouth'가 표정 자체를 잠가서 도적에게 털린 컷·관아에 끌려간 컷·앓는 노인을 돌보는 컷까지 주인공이 웃고 있었다. 공포 금지(menacing/frightening)는 그대로 두고, '표정은 장면을 따른다 + 기본 미소 금지'로 바꿨다. scene_negative에도 NO DEFAULT SMILE을 맨 앞에 넣었다. 되돌리려면 style.prev_20260818.json.
